messages.subject: fm_spTransform error
parts:
Hi, I am attempting to do a transformation of my coordinate system from meters to kilometers for length units but keep getting tripped up in errors. I haven't been able to find a solution and was hoping someone on here might have encountered (and solved) a similar problem. Code and error below. Any suggestions much appreciated. I should note I've tried doing this in an Albers projection as well although I was pretty sure from the beginning it was user-error and not the projection that was an issue. 

train<-read.csv("...trainingdata.csv")
test<-read.csv(".../testingdata.csv")
xy<-read.dbf(".../SegmentCentroidsW.dbf")
train<-merge(train[,c("segid","YR","NIB","group","id","id2","pond.std","Total")],xy[,c("SEGMENTID","LONG1","LAT1")],by.x="segid",by.y="SEGMENTID",all.x=TRUE)
projt<-st_read(".../SegmentCentroidsW.shp")
#=====================================================
#Change projection to km
#=====================================================
st_crs(projt)<-4326
crs.m<-crs(projt)
crs.KM<-fm_crs_set_lengthunit(crs.m,unit="kilometre")
Loc2<-st_as_sf(train,coords=c("LONG1","LAT1"), crs = 4326)
Loc<-fm_spTransform(Loc2,crs.m,crs.KM)

2 MAIN ERROR MESSAGES BELOW
FIRST
Error in fm_crs_bounds_check(x, bounds) :
  inherits(x, "matrix") is not TRUE

SECOND
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In showSRID(SRS_string, format = "PROJ", multiline = "NO", prefer_proj = prefer_proj) :
  Discarded ellps unknown in Proj4 definition: +proj=longlat +R=1 +no_defs +type=crs
2: In showSRID(SRS_string, format = "PROJ", multiline = "NO", prefer_proj = prefer_proj) :
  Discarded datum unknown in Proj4 definition
3: In showSRID(SRS_string, format = "PROJ", multiline = "NO", prefer_proj = prefer_proj) :
  Discarded ellps unknown in Proj4 definition: +proj=longlat +R=6378137 +no_defs +type=crs
4: In showSRID(SRS_string, format = "PROJ", multiline = "NO", prefer_proj = prefer_proj) :
  Discarded datum unknown in Proj4 definition
5: In showSRID(SRS_string, format = "PROJ", multiline = "NO", prefer_proj = prefer_proj) :
  Discarded ellps unknown in Proj4 definition: +proj=longlat +R=6378137 +no_defs +type=crs
6: In showSRID(SRS_string, format = "PROJ", multiline = "NO", prefer_proj = prefer_proj) :
  Discarded datum unknown in Proj4 definition
7: In showSRID(SRS_string, format = "PROJ", multiline = "NO", prefer_proj = prefer_proj) :
  Discarded ellps unknown in Proj4 definition: +proj=geocent +R=1 +units=m +no_defs +type=crs
8: In showSRID(SRS_string, format = "PROJ", multiline = "NO", prefer_proj = prefer_proj) :
  Discarded datum unknown in Proj4 definition

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] fm_spTransform error
parts:
Hi,
Please post this as a Issue on the inlabru GitHub. I at all possible, please make it a reprex, I.e. without a separate dataset; the problem should appear for a manually constructed tiny toy data set as well. Also state clearly precisely what package version you used.
There was a recent bug fix regarding precisely the use of epsg 4326 and length unit conversions, so this may be related to that (and posterior ally already fixed in the latest development version).

Finn

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] fm_spTransform error
parts:
Thanks for the bug posting.
The answer on https://github.com/inlabru-org/inlabru/issues/156 can be
summarised by
1. inlabru (and INLA) doesn't fully support sf objects yet, so convert
them to sp objects first (SpatialPoints e.g.)
2. Setting length units on the epsg:4326 crs has no effect, since it's
in long/lat and doesn't have a projection length scale.

Finn
